summary: The index is composed of the exchange-listed common stock (or depositary receipts) of marine shipping, air freight and courier, and port and harbor operating companies of any size across the globe in developed or emerging markets. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in Cargo Companies.
